definitions.fieldCoordinate: Curves use signed Y when every field X is zero; otherwise their field abscissa is hypot(declared X, declared Y). Original fieldX/fieldY are retained in table rows.
definitions.method: Chief-referenced optical path difference at the current image plane, corrected to a reference sphere centered on the monochromatic chief intercept. Sphere distance uses the primary paraxial exit-pupil conjugate divided by chief direction Z.
definitions.removal: Raw RMS retains piston and tilt. Piston-removed RMS subtracts a weighted mean. Piston+tilt-removed RMS fits [1, final direction cosine X, final direction cosine Y] by weighted least squares; defocus is retained. The headline rmsWaves/rmsNm and maps.values use piston+tilt removal.
definitions.weighting: Normalized pupil quadrature weights multiplied by the engine's Gaussian amplitude apodization, matching standalone OpticalSystem.evaluate. For a map, each transmitted grid point has equal area weight before apodization.
definitions.spectrum: Each wavelength is evaluated independently; wavefront phase is not averaged across wavelengths.

geometry.scope: Nominal coaxial spherical/plane solids, declared full OD, sampled configured-field/spectrum ray envelope and supplied scalar loss budgets.
limitations: No tilted/decentred elements, aspheres, stepped edges, flange or truncated spherical solids.
Ray coverage is the stated finite field/wavelength/pupil sampling, not a continuous-domain bound.
Mounts, spacers, insertion, bevel/support contact geometry, tooling, stress, coatings and manufacturing yield require separate evidence.

method.geometry: analytic spherical monotonic extrema and complete cap nearest-point candidate enumeration
method.ray_envelope: Optiwork actual physical launcher and native refractive trace including exact pupil rim
